description: Complete 6-function Apollo 11 Lunar Module Descent Propulsion System (DPS) flight computer. Decompiled binary decouples propulsion throttle response curves (0x00403000), mascon gravity gradient anomalies (0x00403080), and crater topography (0x00403100) from the Newtonian integration step loop. FalkorDB multi-agent swarm maps memory provenance and resolves call topology into compilable, flight-ready C.

global_memory.label: LUNAR_GRAVITY_ANOMALY
global_memory.description: Localized lunar mascon gravitational field variations (m/s^2)

global_memory.label: TERRAIN_SURFACE_PROFILE
global_memory.description: Landing site elevation profile with crater walls and Mare Tranquillitatis flat landing pad

global_memory.label: FLIGHT_TELEMETRY_BLOCK
global_memory.description: Vehicle dynamic state registers: x, y, vx, vy, pitch, fuel_mass, throttle, total_mass, status
